statement: c7e5c36 (Aug 25 'release: deploy NEXUS Autopilot v2.0.0rc2 cloud hardened', which deleted the old nexus_brain graph-execution engine and nexus_control_plane.py) was a deliberate, accepted architecture pivot, not an accident -- confirmed by Reza on 2026-09-19. Branches still built on that old architecture are treated as obsolete unless he explicitly asks to revive the graph-execution concept.

Rolling-mill billet schema: keep main's version (220x220mm billet, 300/400/600mm target widths), not feat's 150x150mm/ST1-ST4 schema -- the two were the same underlying 2026-09-14 conversation with Reza, not two independent facts.

PRJ-STEEL-ROLLING-LINE-01 basis changed on 2026-09-21 to the slab line: slab 400x125x3000, 20 t/h furnace, two-high D600x600, up to 3 m/s, DC drive. All billet-line data (150x150 / 220x220 billet, ST1-ST4, AC 1250 kW/999 rpm, 1:9.8) is SUPERSEDED and retained, not deleted.
No message, RFQ/RFI or quotation request goes to any vendor or third party without Reza's explicit approval of recipient and exact text; Claude drafts only.

Vendor RFIs of the slab line are at v5.1 (2026-09-26): gearbox torques are stated at the gearbox output (>=345/~420/>=685/840 kN.m), regen >=680 kW at 3 s, accel+brake 204-374/h; nexus_checks --transmission keeps them equal to slab_line_design.
PRJ-STEEL-REROLL-01 opened 2026-09-28 as an isolated project (re-rolling 12/15/20 mm offcuts to 6/8/10 mm); only option C may cite the slab-line project's recorded status.
